title: Designing Value-Centered Consent Interfaces: A Mixed-Methods Approach to Support Patient Values in Data-Sharing Decisions
reasoning: The paper is an empirical study in the field of Human-Computer Interaction, specifically focusing on the design and evaluation of user interfaces for medical consent. While it incorporates bioethical principles (such as autonomy and beneficence) to guide its 'Value-Centered' design and measures 'value congruence', it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as general systems or within the context of AI models.
